Name: Abiram
Summary: Abiram, son of Eliab, joined Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron and refused to come up when Moses summoned him.
KeyStory: Abiram stood at the door of his tent with his family as the ground opened and swallowed the rebels alive.
RelatedPeople: Dathan; Eliab, Son of Pallu; Korah, Son of Izhar; Moses; Aaron
LifeLesson: Pride that will not listen ends where the ground gives way.
